analysis.title: GS Bartlett - GS TMT TODAY 11.13.26
key_insights: Futures roughly flat (Nasdaq slightly down, S&P +20bps) on quiet overnight macro news. Megacap tech remains the focus as markets absorb Jensen Huang's departure from NVDA.

NVDA turned over 2bn shares week-to-date, about 10% of its float. The GS desk saw heavy asset manager supply, met by retail demand and some hedge fund demand in both cash and vol products. NVDA was +2% pre-market.

MSFT fell about 1-1.5% pre-market on a global Microsoft 365 outage, being restored gradually (Asia-Pacific traffic restoring, Europe recovering). The outage drove a renewed bid for security software (PANW, CRWD, OKTA, S).
CSCO F1Q27 EPS $1.40 beat GS/consensus of $1.33/$1.32, driven by Networking revenue and opex (EBIT margin). Orders missed. Stock -3% pre-market.

CSCO raised F2027 revenue guidance by $2.5bn at the midpoint ($1.5bn AI, $1.0bn other), EBIT margin to 36% (from 35%), and EPS by 8% to $5.47-$5.53 (from $5.05-$5.11). GS flags that a growing hyperscale mix may pressure gross margin in F2H27.

AMAT FQ4 net sales $10.4bn vs consensus $10.28bn, gross margin 50.6% vs 50.4% consensus. FQ1 guide of $10.6-11.6bn sales and $4.15-4.55 EPS is above consensus of $10.9bn and $4.26. Stock roughly flat to +60bps pre-market.

Cerebras (CBRS) beat on core metrics, raised its outlook and announced new deals with ORCL and MSFT. Stock +13% to +18% (premarket and post print). Investors are watching a delay in the OpenAI contract rollout. The company says it cannot find enough cloud capacity and expects to be back on track in 2H of next year, and calls rumors of technical inability to support OpenAI models false.
Today's calendar: US PPI at 8:30am and Fed speakers Goolsbee, Collins (twice), Logan, Bowman, Daly and Jefferson.
Next week: Warsh speaks Monday 11/16, NVDA reports 11/17, retail earnings (HD 11/17, LOW/TGT 11/18, WMT 11/19), China tech earnings (Tencent 11/18, BABA 11/19), and Trump meets Xi on 11/18-11/19.

GS US Autos & Industrial Tech note on AI and datacenter risk: states where incoming governors proposed stricter datacenter rules account for about 45% of planned future datacenter capacity, with Texas about a quarter of the total.

GS Business & Information Services review: Info Services organic growth slowed to 6.8% y/y in CY3Q from 8.8% in CY2Q, and Business Services improved to 3.5% from 3.2%. AI outcomes diverged: proprietary data supported MSCI, VRSK, EFX, TRU, MCO and SPGI, while AI-search disruption pressured PXED and ROL, and AI competition questions remained at TRI, IT and FDS.
GS Buy ideas in Business & Information Services are CTAS, IRM, MCO, SPGI and TRI. Sell ideas are BV, FDS and HRB. Consensus CY2026 EPS estimates fell modestly, with larger cuts at BV, PXED and KLC.
Street actions: AMAT downgraded to Hold (Summit Insights), AVGO to Neutral (Rothschild), CTSH to Hold (Deutsche). Roth Capital initiated ADI, ALGM and POWI at Buy.

sector_views.rationale: Fundamentals are resilient but the outlook is more varied. Guidance was largely maintained or raised, while consensus CY2026 EPS fell modestly. Info Services growth slowed and Business Services improved modestly.
GS analyzes downside scenarios from stricter state datacenter regulation and the debate on AI capex returns. States with proposed stricter rules hold about 45% of planned capacity.

earnings_insights: CSCO F1Q27 (reported 11/12 after the close): EPS $1.40 reported vs GS estimate $1.33 and consensus $1.32. Networking revenue and opex drove the beat, and orders missed. F2027 guidance raised: revenue +$2.5bn at the midpoint, EBIT margin 36% (prior 35%), EPS $5.47-$5.53 (prior $5.05-$5.11).

AMAT FQ4 (reported): net sales $10.4bn vs consensus $10.28bn, gross margin 50.6% vs consensus 50.4%. FQ1 guide (forward): net sales $10.6-11.6bn vs consensus $10.9bn, EPS $4.15-4.55 vs consensus $4.26.

CBRS (Cerebras) reported a beat across core metrics and raised its outlook, with new deals with ORCL and MSFT. The OpenAI contract rollout is delayed by cloud capacity constraints, with the company expecting to be back on track in 2H of next year.

Business & Information Services 3Q: Info Services organic revenue growth slowed to 6.8% y/y from 8.8% in CY2Q. Business Services improved to 3.5% from 3.2%. Consensus CY2026 EPS estimates declined modestly, with larger cuts at BV, PXED and KLC.
Upcoming earnings: NVDA 11/17, HD 11/17, LOW and TGT 11/18, WMT 11/19, Tencent 11/18, BABA 11/19.
